lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ
lines.transliteration: ik-ōṅkār sat nām karatā purakh nirabhau niravair
lines.english: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: akāl mūrat ajūnī saibhaṅ gur prasād
lines.english: Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace.
True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hai bhī sach nānak hōsī bhī sach
lines.english: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||
